notes.title: Hotfix 0.03
notes.content:
Fixed an issue with the game ending, now our endless runs have an ending.

Other identified bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.02
notes.content:
Fixed the inability to shop at the blacksmith.
Adjusted the damage and purchase amount of weapons.
Increased barrel damage.
Overhauled buggy traps and zones.
Changed the merchant skin.
Fixed the inability to adjust the weapon sound volume.
Removed the tutorial from the menu and integrated it into the village.

Fixed various reported in-game bugs.

notes.title: First Update
notes.content:
Fixed the inability to shop in the store.
Added outliner to make merchants more visible.
Fixed the issue with music not changing level.
Fixed detected translation errors.
Fixed various in-game bugs that were detected.

Known Bugs :
Tutorial related bugs.
